summary: Nu-Med Plus filed an 8-K on October 19, 2026 disclosing a private placement of 171,232 Series A Preferred shares to two accredited investors for aggregate proceeds of $450,000, or $2.628 per preferred share, alongside 50,000 Series A Preferred shares issued to a consultant for services. The subscription agreements carry piggy-back registration rights permitting resale inclusion of conversion shares in any secondary-offering registration statement filed within two years. Placements relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, with no commissions paid. This is a routine unregistered equity financing, not a special situation; watch dilution from preferred conversion and any resale registration.
